goal:
The exported report is hard to use: rows land in whatever order they were entered,
so finding a customer means eyeballing the whole sheet. The docs promise customers
in alphabetical order ignoring case, and when two customers differ only by case the
earlier submission should come first. Please make the export honor that.

hows.text: Implement a case-insensitive sorting algorithm in the export module that normalizes all customer names to lowercase, sorts them alphabetically, and then restores the original casing for the final output.
hows.reason: This directly enforces the documented alphabetical order requirement while preserving the original casing, providing a robust and standard solution.

hows.text: Introduce a custom, case-insensitive comparator function specifically for the customer rows, applying it during the export process to ensure earlier submissions with differing only by case are prioritized.
hows.reason: This approach isolates the sorting logic to the specific customer data, ensuring strict adherence to the case-sensitive ordering rule without altering the broader export logic.
